post.description:
Authenticate user and return JWT tokens (FR-USER-01).

Request body
------------
.. code-block:: json

    {"email": "...", "password": "..."}

Responses
---------
200
    ``{"data": {"access_token": "...", "refresh_token": "...", "user": {...}}}``
401
    ``{"error": {"code": "AUTH-001", "message": "Invalid email or password"}}``
403
    ``{"error": {"code": "AUTH-002", "message": "Account is not active"}}``

schema.title: Response Login Api V1 Auth Login Post

post.description:
Accept an invitation and create a new user account (FR-USER-02).

Request body
------------
.. code-block:: json

    {"invite_token": "...", "full_name": "...", "password": "...", "phone": "..."}

Responses
---------
201
    ``{"data": {"id": "...", "email": "...", "full_name": "...", "property_scopes": [], "is_active": true}}``
400
    ``{"error": {"code": "VAL-400", "message": "..."}}`` (validation error)
409
    ``{"error": {"code": "AUTH-004", "message": "Email already in use"}}``

schema.title: Response Register Api V1 Auth Register Post

post.description:
Send an invitation link to a new user (FR-USER-02).

Requires the current user to have sufficient property scope
(validated in the service layer).

Request body
------------
.. code-block:: json

    {"email": "...", "property_id": "..."}

Responses
---------
201
    ``{"data": {"invite_link": "..."}}``
403
    ``{"error": {"code": "AUTH-005", "message": "Insufficient property scope"}}``
409
    ``{"error": {"code": "AUTH-004", "message": "Email already in use"}}``

schema.title: Response Invite Api V1 Auth Invite Post

post.description:
Issue a new access token from a valid refresh token (FR-USER-03).

Request body
------------
.. code-block:: json

    {"refresh_token": "..."}

Responses
---------
200
    ``{"data": {"access_token": "..."}}``
401
    ``{"error": {"code": "AUTH-007", "message": "Invalid or expired refresh token"}}``

schema.title: Response Refresh Api V1 Auth Refresh Post

get.description:
Return the authenticated user's profile (FR-USER-01).

Requires a valid Bearer token in the ``Authorization`` header.

Responses
---------
200
    ``{"data": {"id": "...", "email": "...", "full_name": "...", "property_scopes": [], "is_active": true}}``
401
    ``{"error": {"code": "AUTH-009", "message": "Invalid or expired access token"}}``

AuthRequest.title: AuthRequest
AuthRequest.description:
Payload for ``POST /api/v1/auth/login`` (SDD §3.3).

Validates that the password meets minimum length and complexity
requirements before reaching the service layer.

ContractResponse.title: ContractResponse
ContractResponse.description: Response body for a single Contract resource (SDD §3.1 format).

ContractStatus.title: ContractStatus
ContractStatus.description:
Possible states for a Contract (SDD §6.2: State Machines).

Transitions:
    draft ──→ active (via signing)
    active ──→ terminated (via terminate_contract, BR-04)
    active ──→ expired (auto via scheduler when end_date < today)
    terminated ──→ (immutable, new contract created for renew)
    expired ──→ (immutable)

CreateContractRequest.title: CreateContractRequest
CreateContractRequest.description:
Request body for POST /api/v1/contracts (SDD §3.3).

Validation:
    - ``end_date`` must be after ``start_date``.
    - ``monthly_rent`` must be positive.
    - ``deposit_amount`` must be >= 0.
    - ``start_date`` must not be in the past (service layer also checks).
    - BR-01/BR-02 enforced in service layer (not here).

CreateMaintenanceRequest.title: CreateMaintenanceRequest
CreateMaintenanceRequest.description:
Request body for POST /api/v1/maintenance-requests.

Validation:
    - ``title``: min 3 characters.
    - ``description``: min 10 characters.
    - ``priority``: must be a valid Priority enum value.
    - ``room_id``: must be a valid UUID.
    - ``images``: max 5 (future).

CreateMeterReadingRequest.title: CreateMeterReadingRequest
CreateMeterReadingRequest.description:
Request body for POST /api/v1/meter-readings.

Validation:
    - BR-07: electric_current >= electric_previous, water_current >= water_previous
    - billing_month: 1-12, billing_year: >= 2020

CreatePropertyRequest.title: CreatePropertyRequest
CreatePropertyRequest.description:
Request body for POST /api/v1/properties.

Validation:
    - ``billing_due_day`` must be 1-28.
    - ``min_deposit_months`` >= 1.
    - ``name`` must not be empty.

CreateTenantRequest.title: CreateTenantRequest
CreateTenantRequest.description:
Request body for POST /api/v1/tenants.

Validation:
    - ``phone`` must be a valid Thai phone number (10 digits, starts with 0).
    - ``id_card_number`` must be 13 digits (Thai national ID format).
    - ``email`` is optional but must be valid if provided.

ExtendLeaseRequest.title: ExtendLeaseRequest
ExtendLeaseRequest.description:
Request body for POST /api/v1/contracts/{id}/extend.

Validation:
    - ``new_end_date`` must be after the current end_date.

GenerateInvoiceRequest.title: GenerateInvoiceRequest
GenerateInvoiceRequest.description:
Request body for POST /api/v1/invoices/generate.

Validation:
    - billing_month: 1-12, billing_year >= 2020

InviteRequest.title: InviteRequest
InviteRequest.description:
Payload for ``POST /api/v1/auth/invite`` (SDD §3.3).

An admin sends an invitation for a specific email address and property.

.. note::
   Not strict so that string-encoded UUIDs from JSON deserialisation
   are automatically coerced to ``uuid.UUID``.

InvoiceDetailResponse.title: InvoiceDetailResponse
InvoiceDetailResponse.description: Response for GET /api/v1/invoices/{id} — includes line items.

InvoiceLineItemResponse.title: InvoiceLineItemResponse
InvoiceLineItemResponse.description: Response body for a single InvoiceLineItem.

InvoiceResponse.title: InvoiceResponse
InvoiceResponse.description: Response body for a single Invoice resource.

LeaseExtensionResponse.title: LeaseExtensionResponse
LeaseExtensionResponse.description: Lease extension record embedded in ContractResponse.

LeaseHistoryItem.title: LeaseHistoryItem
LeaseHistoryItem.description: A single lease history entry for a room.

MaintenanceResponse.title: MaintenanceResponse
MaintenanceResponse.description: Response body for a single MaintenanceRequest resource (SDD §3.1).

MaintenanceStatus.title: MaintenanceStatus
MaintenanceStatus.description:
Possible states for a MaintenanceRequest (BR-09 workflow).

Valid transitions:
    pending ──→ in_progress
    in_progress ──→ resolved
    in_progress ──→ cancelled
    pending ──→ cancelled

MeterHistoryResponse.title: MeterHistoryResponse
MeterHistoryResponse.description: Paginated response for meter reading history.

MeterReadingResponse.title: MeterReadingResponse
MeterReadingResponse.description: Response body for a single MeterReading resource.

PaymentMethod.title: PaymentMethod
PaymentMethod.description: Payment methods accepted by the system.

PaymentResponse.title: PaymentResponse
PaymentResponse.description: Response body for a single Payment resource.

Priority.title: Priority
Priority.description: Priority level for a maintenance request.

PropertyListResponse.title: PropertyListResponse
PropertyListResponse.description: Response for GET /api/v1/properties — list all properties.

PropertyResponse.title: PropertyResponse
PropertyResponse.description: Response body for a single Property resource (SDD §3.1 format).

RecordPaymentRequest.title: RecordPaymentRequest
RecordPaymentRequest.description:
Request body for POST /api/v1/payments.

Validation:
    - amount > 0
    - method must be a valid PaymentMethod enum value

RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest
RegisterRequest.description:
Payload for ``POST /api/v1/auth/register`` (SDD §3.3).

Carries the invite token alongside the new user's profile data.

RenewContractRequest.title: RenewContractRequest
RenewContractRequest.description:
Request body for POST /api/v1/contracts/{id}/renew.

Creates a new contract record based on the original.  The original
contract must be in ``terminated`` or ``expired`` state (CONT-005).

RevenueMetric.title: RevenueMetric
RevenueMetric.description: Single revenue data point for a period.

RoomResponse.title: RoomResponse
RoomResponse.description:
Response body for a single Room resource (SDD §3.1 format).

Note: ``images`` is omitted from the response if ``None``.

RoomStatus.title: RoomStatus
RoomStatus.description: Possible states for a room (SDD §6: State Machines).

TenantResponse.title: TenantResponse
TenantResponse.description:
Response body for a single Tenant resource (SDD §3.1 format).

**Security:** ``id_card_number_encrypted`` is deliberately omitted.
Sensitive personal data is never returned through the API.

TerminateContractRequest.title: TerminateContractRequest
TerminateContractRequest.description:
Request body for POST /api/v1/contracts/{id}/terminate (SDD §3.3).

Validation:
    - ``reason`` is required and must be non-empty.
    - ``termination_date`` defaults to today if not provided.

UpdateMaintenanceStatusRequest.title: UpdateMaintenanceStatusRequest
UpdateMaintenanceStatusRequest.description:
Request body for PATCH /api/v1/maintenance-requests/{id}/status.

Validation:
    - ``status``: must be a valid MaintenanceStatus enum value.
    - BR-09 enforced in service layer.
